project.name: Violet Parfumerie
project.primary_goal: Create a distinctive, calm, luxury fragrance discovery and commerce experience that feels curated rather than crowded.

constraints.tablet_mobile_status: N/A_JUSTIFIED for current visual phase; preserve existing behavior and do not claim fully responsive
constraints.implementation_style: vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript; preserve existing architecture unless a material problem requires change
constraints.visual_completion_requires: rendered evidence + automated sanity gates + Creative Director screenshot inspection
constraints.system_reality: Do not describe static, simulated, deterministic, mock or partial behavior as real AI/production integration.
constraints.creative_direction: Factory and routed skills own repeatable process and verification; ChatGPT acts as Creative Director for taste, hierarchy, brand fit and final visual judgment.
anti_patterns: gradient or glass effects without a brand or hierarchy role
universal hero shells across materially different page roles
merging substantial visual changes without opened rendered screenshots
